sql.query: SELECT ct.id,ct.templateName,ct.description,ct.outputType,ct.templateKey,ct.subjectTemplate,ct.bodyHtml,ct.textTemplate,ct.versionNumber,ct.isActive FROM tbl_contract_templates ct WHERE ct.id=:id AND ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 AND ((ct.outputType='email' AND p.permissionCode='email.configure') OR (ct.outputType<>'email' AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure'))) LIMIT 1

SELECT v.versionNumber,v.createdDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown') createdBy FROM tbl_contract_template_versions v LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=v.createdByUserId WHERE v.templateId=:id AND v.tenantId=:tenantId ORDER BY v.versionNumber DESC
